text: OpenAI-compatible chat completions API for fast LLM inference
quote: Fast LLM inference, OpenAI-compatible. Simple to integrate, easy to scale. Start building in minutes.

text: Point existing OpenAI SDK client at Groq by swapping api_key and base_url
quote: pass your Groq API key to the `api_key` parameter and change the `base_url` to `https://api.groq.com/openai/v1`

text: Hosts GPT-OSS 120B open-weight model with built-in browser search, code execution and reasoning
quote: GPT-OSS 120B is OpenAI's flagship open-weight language model with 120 billion parameters, built in browser search and code execution, and reasoning capabilities.

text: Structured outputs with strict:true guarantee output matches a JSON schema exactly
quote: With strict: true, the model uses constrained decoding to guarantee that the output will always match your schema exactly.

text: Tool use / function calling lets the model take autonomous actions
quote: Tool use (or function calling) is what transforms a language model from a conversational interface into an autonomous agent capable of taking action

text: Point to an MCP server URL and Groq automatically uses its tools without custom tool logic
quote: point to an MCP server URL and the Groq API will start using its tools without you having to implement any tool logic yourself

text: Batch processing runs thousands of async API requests at 50% lower cost with a 24hr-7day window
quote: Batch processing lets you run thousands of API requests at scale by submitting your workload as an asynchronous batch of requests to Groq with 50% lower cost, no impact to your standard rate limits, and 24-hour to 7 day processing window.

text: Multiple service tiers (auto/on-demand/flex) let you tune for latency, throughput and reliability via service_tier parameter
quote: Groq offers multiple service tiers so you can tune for latency, throughput, and reliability. You can distinguish these by providing the service_tier parameter.

text: Flex processing tier gives paid customers 10x higher rate limits than on-demand at the same price
quote: Flex processing is available for all models to paid customers only with 10x higher rate limits compared to on-demand processing. Pricing matches the on-demand tier.

text: Streaming completions token-by-token by setting stream=True
quote: To enable streaming, set the parameter stream=True. The completion function will then return an iterator of completion deltas rather than a single, full completion.

text: Upload and run inference with your own pre-made LoRA adapters on Groq's infrastructure
quote: Groq provides inference services for pre-made Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) adapters... Upload your existing LoRA adapters to run specialized inference while maintaining the performance and efficiency of Groq's infrastructure.

text: Set automated spend limits and receive budget alerts
quote: Spend Limits: Set automated spending limits and receive budget alerts

text: Responses API supports text and image inputs, stateful conversations, and function calling
quote: The Responses API supports both text and image inputs while producing text outputs, stateful conversations, and function calling to connect with external systems.

text: Chat Completions API enables conversational interactions with hosted LLMs
quote: Generating text with Groq's Chat Completions API enables you to have natural, conversational interactions with Groq's large language models.

text: Responses API is fully compatible with OpenAI's Responses API for easy integration
quote: Groq's Responses API is fully compatible with OpenAI's Responses API, making it easy to integrate advanced conversational AI capabilities into your applications.

text: Audio transcription endpoint (e.g. whisper-large-v3-turbo) accepts file uploads
Tool definitions passed as JSON schema via the tools parameter to enable function calling
quote: To use tools, the model must be provided with tool definitions. These tool definitions are in JSON schema format and are passed to the model via the tools parameter

text: MCP tool use via Responses API over HTTPS with Groq handling all orchestration
quote: Groq's Responses API supports remote tool use via MCP servers via HTTPS where Groq handles all orchestration... You don't implement anything - just provide the MCP server URL and authentication.
